source: Magandang aga sa lahat ng nag-atendir sa meeting.
reference: Good morning to everyone who attended the meeting.
note: Hiligaynon 'Maayong aga sa tanan' ASR-forced toward Tagalog particles

source: Kailangan natin aprubahan ang budget para sa susunod na quarter.
reference: We need to approve the budget for the next quarter.
note: Hiligaynon 'Kinahanglan naton…masunod' misheard with Tagalog natin/susunod

source: Si Maria ang responsable sa follow-up.
reference: Maria will be responsible for the follow-up.
note: Shared surface; often routed as Tagalog

source: May tanong ba parte sa agenda?
reference: Are there any questions about the agenda?
note: Hiligaynon 'May pamangkot bala' → Tagalog-leaning 'May tanong ba'

source: Salamat sa inyong oras. Tapos na ang meeting.
reference: Thank you for your time. The meeting is over.
note: Hiligaynon 'Salamat sa inyo nga oras' Tagalogized

source: Hindi gid natin magdesisyon ngayon kung wala pa ang report ng komite.
reference: We really should not decide today if the committee report is not yet available.
note: Mixed: Hiligaynon gid retained amid Tagalog hindi/natin/ngayon/kung

source: Magandang hapon; pakirecord ang action item kay Ana bago matapos ang meeting.
reference: Good afternoon; please record the action item for Ana before the meeting ends.
note: Hiligaynon 'Maayong hapon; palihog i-record…antes' Tagalog-leaning ASR

source: Indi pa ready ang final draft ng minutes.
reference: The final draft of the minutes is not ready yet.
note: Hiligaynon indi + Tagalog ng particles (common Whisper mix)

source: Kinahanglan naton magtambong sa training next week.
reference: We need to attend the training next week.
note: Hiligaynon naton/magtambong kept; English week noise

source: May ara ba sang corrections sa minutes?
reference: Are there any corrections to the minutes?
note: Hiligaynon ara/sang amid Tagalog minutes loanwords
